call_points.text: No numeric FY27 guidance; management only said it will keep working to improve margins through cost reduction and premiumisation.
Net profit fell despite higher EBITDA, on acquisition-related finance cost, depreciation and amortisation, and some deal cost.
On the auditor's goodwill key audit matter, the CFO said goodwill is tested yearly and no impairment is needed.
Close to 30% of business comes from modern trade, e-commerce and quick commerce, and the company keeps investing there.
International operations are now 25-30% of revenue, helped by Comfort Click, which the Chairman said reduces seasonal dependence.
Complan is seeing an uptake through occasion-based segmentation, line extensions, medical marketing and ready-to-use formats.
Seasonal brands were hit by delayed summers and unseasonal rainfall; skincare and haircare grew on innovation and premiumisation.
The company was rated at the 99th percentile in the S&P ESG survey and is in the S&P Global Sustainability Yearbook 2026.
A dividend of ₹1.20 per share (60%) for FY26 was on the AGM agenda.
Comfort Click was EPS accretive in Q4 FY26 and guided accretive for FY27.
Effective tax rate guided at 25% bracket for FY27 and FY28.
Domestic seasonal portfolio declined 9.8% YoY in Q4 due to unseasonal rains.
Organized channels reached 30% of domestic business in FY26 up from 24%.
Quick commerce accounts for 7% to 8% of total domestic business.
International business like-for-like sales grew 31.4% YoY in Q4 FY26.
Acquisition Bridge loan in GBP refinanced into lower cost Euro facility.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,484.7 Cr (+62.6% YoY), net profit ₹162 Cr (-5.8% YoY).
2026-05-18: Q4FY26 press release — net sales ₹1,476 Cr (+62.1% YoY), FY26 net sales ₹3,940 Cr (+46.4%), FY26 EBITDA ₹510 Cr (+34.2%), FY26 PAT ₹197 Cr.
Zydus Wellness Limited shared the audio recording of its Investor Call on audited Q4-FY26 results via its website on May 18, 2026, signed by **NANDISH P. JOSHI** and **PRADIP JOSHI**.
Zydus Wellness hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings call, guiding to a 17-18% EBITDA margin ex-Comfort Click in 2 years and highlighting EPS accretive status of Comfort Click.

At its 32nd AGM on 4 August 2026, Zydus Wellness reported FY26 revenue up 46.2% to ₹3,661 Cr and EBITDA up 34.2% to ₹510 Cr, with net profit lower on Comfort Click acquisition finance cost and depreciation.
Zydus Wellness clarified to the exchange that its response is awaited regarding an FSSAI news report.

On October 23, 2026, Zydus Wellness clarified to exchanges that it received an FSSAI notice on September 24, 2026 regarding product claims and submitted its response on October 4, 2026, stating the notice has no material impact.
